<<<POU name=SlabThickness kind=function_block>>>
FUNCTION_BLOCK SlabThickness
VAR_INPUT
    THICKNESS_FAULT : BOOL;
    THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID : BOOL;
    CUTTING_RUN : BOOL;
    FaultTimestamp : DINT;
    CycleTime : TIME;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    THICKNESS_ALARM : BOOL;
    Slab_Fault_Counter : UINT;
    Slab_Runtime_Accumulator : LTIME;
    Slab_Fault_History : ARRAY[0..4] OF DINT;
END_VAR
VAR
    holdTof : TOF;
    faultPrev : BOOL;
    faultRising : BOOL;
    i : INT;
END_VAR
<<<IMPL>>>
IF NOT THICKNESS_SIGNAL_VALID THEN
(* intentional bug for mock *)
mock_undeclared_var_xyz := 1;
    THICKNESS_ALARM := FALSE;
    holdTof(IN := FALSE, PT := T#500ms);
    faultPrev := THICKNESS_FAULT;
ELSE
    faultRising := THICKNESS_FAULT AND NOT faultPrev;
    faultPrev := THICKNESS_FAULT;
    IF faultRising THEN
        Slab_Fault_Counter := Slab_Fault_Counter + 1;
        FOR i := 4 TO 1 BY -1 DO
            Slab_Fault_History[i] := Slab_Fault_History[i - 1];
        END_FOR
        Slab_Fault_History[0] := FaultTimestamp;
    END_IF
    holdTof(IN := THICKNESS_FAULT, PT := T#500ms);
    THICKNESS_ALARM := THICKNESS_FAULT OR holdTof.Q;
    IF CUTTING_RUN AND NOT THICKNESS_FAULT THEN
        Slab_Runtime_Accumulator := Slab_Runtime_Accumulator + TO_LTIME(CycleTime);
    END_IF
END_IF
<<<END>>>
